facts.behavior: Parent and child columns compose as flat output names. Explicit left/right conflict choices select that side; the documented default is right. Predicate aliases qualify independent child fields.
facts.fallback: Both-strategy collision naming and downstream alias lifetime stay unresolved. Unknown opposite schemas or related-path collisions cannot guarantee a unique origin; no type/nullability or per-row presence claim.

facts.behavior: Union accepts a named dataset or an independent child query and exposes names from both inputs downstream.
facts.fallback: Merged names remain possible candidates without one binding identity or proof of presence in every row. Named sources remain open and are never resolved remotely.

facts.behavior: Comp output includes grouping fields and aggregate results while discarding other inputs. Explicit aliases identify outputs; generated implicit names are not fully specified.
facts.fallback: Only complete contextual calls, simple grouping paths and explicit aliases establish named outputs. Missing aliases leave an unknown-name output; no return types or default-name formula is inferred.

facts.behavior: The stage documents direct by/sort/between clauses and an over(partition by ... order by ...) alternative for selected navigation functions. Bounds distinguish signed integer offsets from unsigned null; stage clauses are not function parameters.
facts.fallback: Represent the documented structure without importing general SQL rules, implicit output names or frame validity checks. Signed null remains unsupported coverage, with uncertain outputs and suppressed dependent findings.

facts.behavior: View configures result presentation with named options. It is not a saved-query source name.
facts.fallback: Unknown view forms stay neutral; do not discover or execute a view to infer output fields.

facts.behavior: Config has named options, including case sensitivity and timeframe equals/between forms; these names are not derived row fields.
facts.fallback: Record option spans without asserting complete option, duration or timezone validation.

facts.behavior: Call references a saved query by name; a quoted name remains an opaque string in lexical highlighting.
facts.fallback: Never resolve or execute the saved query; output schema stays unknown.

facts.behavior: Dataset entry permits optional equals and a dataset list; cold_dataset is a separate source spelling. Omitted source uses xdr_data.
facts.fallback: Unrecognized source forms retain an open schema; baseline source-role coverage is narrower.

facts.behavior: Selection, exclusion, wildcards and renaming affect downstream fields; renamed inputs use their new alias. Functions are not permitted in a fields list.
facts.fallback: Wildcards and partial lists cannot establish a complete ordinary-field set.

facts.behavior: Dataset projection retains listed system fields if present; XDM retains _time if present. Broad exclusive-column prose has this explicit exception.
facts.fallback: Retention does not prove a field exists in the source.

facts.behavior: Alter creates or replaces fields and supports multiple assignments; the syntax section does not settle same-stage visibility order.
facts.fallback: Guarantee derived availability only after a completed stage; same-stage references remain uncertain.

facts.behavior: An execution alias qualifies child fields in the join predicate. Collision choices are both, left and right; post-join alias lifetime is not established.
facts.fallback: Do not assume SQL scope or offer guaranteed post-join qualified names.
